name: Yampa River — Craig and Little Yampa Canyon
blurb: Yampa River State Park sites around Craig and the 32-mile Little Yampa Canyon to Duffy Mountain.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

notices.title: Craig River Park whitewater features
notices.text: This reach includes engineered whitewater features above Loudy Simpson. Do not treat the whole trip as a Class I float. Check the City of Craig and sheriff for current conditions and restrictions, and scout before committing.

notices.title: Low-water advisory
notices.text: CPW’s June 23, 2026 low-water advisory remains posted when checked November 9. The advisory discourages downstream travel. Check current CPW conditions before launching.

takeOutAccess.note: CPW explicitly lists a developed launch. The City of Craig trail map places the boat ramp northwest of the ball fields, and imagery shows the corresponding access road, turnaround and ramp. The coordinate is an imagery placement matched to that city map, not an agency GPS fix. Craig reports ramp completion in spring 2024 and the river-park project in October 2025; imagery may predate that construction. Use the current signed ramp, not the old park-center directions pin.
takeOutAccess.directions: Enter Loudy Simpson Park from Highway 394 south of Craig. Follow the park road northwest of the ball fields to the signed river launch parking. The marker is the launch vicinity, not an exact water entry. Check local signs and river-park conditions before launching.
